## What this manual is for

Use this manual for exact menus, parameters, files, checks, failure conditions
and recovery procedures. Operational responsibility and retained evidence
belong in the [Operations Manual](../operations/index.qmd); statistical meaning
and interpretation belong in the [Public Methods Manual](../methods/index.qmd).

## Architecture

| Layer | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| **REDCap and controlled sources** | Hold authoritative confidential records. |
| **Stata** | Prepare analytical inputs, calculate statistics, apply publication controls and promote approved public packages. |
| **Quarto** | Present approved public outputs without becoming a parallel analytical workflow. |
| **GitHub** | Version and deploy the static, public-safe Info-Hub. |

Private data, staging packages, credentials, logs and review evidence remain
outside Git. Generated outputs are corrected only through source data or
version-controlled code and a rerun.
